newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds firm on good Italian price data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds firm on good Italian price data.

text.p: Portuguese bonds rose in light trade, encouraged by the firm trend of peripheral markets and buoyed by news that consumer price inflation in Italy had dropped to the lowest level in 27 years.
"Futures and cash are firmer, comforted by the rise of peripherals," a dealer said.
Another said: "Support is firm along the yield curve."
Money rates were steady. Overnight and tomorrow/next stood at 6.83/6.85 percent, compared with 6.80/6.83 percent yesterday.
